docs.text:
Kincaid’s collection of fairy tales of the Deccan, told by the Marāṭhā nurses and village women, with the author’s introduction on their sources (London, 1914). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the New York Public Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Deccan nursery tales; or, Fairy tales from the south · Kincaid, C. A. (Charles Augustus), 1870-1954 · [1914], 184 scanned pages. Published 1914; Charles Augustus Kincaid died 1954 and the illustrator M. V. Dhurandhar 1944; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
